title_zh: 暂缓虚构丑闻标题并安排核实

scenario.label_zh: 虚构资助指控的报道核查
scenario.goal_zh: 区分未证实的指控和已知资料，约定索取付款证据与当事方回应后再决定报道措辞

context_zh: 虚构新闻编辑练习中，两人处理关于艺术资助的匿名指控，内容不是现实新闻。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: This anonymous message calls the missing arts grant a scandal. Shall that be our headline?

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Not yet. Careful reporting means checking whether the money is actually missing.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: The amount in the message is shocking, but there is no document attached.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Ask the sender what the records reveal and whether we can see those records ourselves.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Should I also contact a representative of the arts centre?

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Yes. Ask about the payment schedule and give them the specific claim to answer.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: I'll request the records and their response. Until then, I'll leave that headline out.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Good. An allegation in a message is not a finding we have verified.
